title: xAI Will Buy Your Home If You Drop the Noise Lawsuit
dek: Southaven residents must waive legal claims over xAI's power plant to sell.

facts.label: Homes targeted, per a local realtor
Temporary gas turbines at the plant

caption:
Sell your house to xAI, but only if you give up your right to sue. 🏠

In Southaven, Mississippi, MZX, the xAI subsidiary running a gas-fired power plant for Elon Musk's data centers, is offering to buy homes in the Colonial Hills neighborhood. The catch: sellers must sign a release of all claims tied to a pending lawsuit over the plant's near-constant noise and vibrations. One realtor says the target is 418 homes, with 18 owners already on board.

The plant runs 69 temporary gas turbines feeding xAI's Grok expansion. Residents describe a high-pitched hum and a sound like an airplane overhead, and xAI also faces environmental penalties, unpaid contractor claims and an NAACP permit lawsuit.

At AI Parabellum, we see this as a sharp example of the AI data center boom colliding with the people living next door. Would you take the deal?
